description: Controller record of the pull request the correction Step reported, as a read-only GitHub read showed it once the receipt check passed: its identity and the heads downstream needs; it records and judges nothing else

branch.description: The pull request's head branch in the target repository, without refs/heads/

head_sha.description: The pull request's head when it was read, which may be newer than reported_head

reported_head.description: The head the correction Step reported and the worktree confirmed, which is head_sha or one of its ancestors

compare_status.description: identical when reported_head is head_sha, without a compare read; otherwise the status GitHub's compare of reported_head to head_sha returned
